SCI-MAP v0.2 DOCUMENT r0.3 — FINAL MICRO-REPAIR,
PROFILE-ACTIVATION, EMPTY-SUPPORT, RESPONSE-FAMILY,
AND FREEZE-PREFLIGHT DIRECTIVE

The SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.2 scientific architecture is accepted as the basis for the
freeze candidate.

Do not perform another broad MAP derivation.

Preserve:

- the ordinary positive-coefficient observation estimator;
- exact realized SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 transformed input;
- no direct CAL fallback, PTC-disabled route, or inferred no-op PTC product;
- exact stable occurrence identity and same-n AST coordinate association;
- SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1;
- the explicitly selected PTC-owned uniform coefficient family;
- no unity or alternate-family fallback;
- the five-stage MAP lifecycle:
      requested
      effective
      observation_resolved
      applied
      realized;
- the complete MAP-local realized operator;
- fixed-state, PTC-full-procedure, and PTC+MAP-re-resolved response families;
- complete comparison-space records for numerical procedure differences;
- original-footprint exposure using each unique original's own AST ALIGN-grid
  coordinate;
- no exposure from synthesis, replacement, donor reuse, filtering, or
  decimation;
- the exact coverage_cut order statistic;
- separate normalization and science-support predicates;
- the typed above-one override;
- six independently requestable observation/coadd product roles;
- response/covariance-unavailable base products;
- role-qualified atomic coadd admission;
- centered-integer common-grid placement;
- equal-observation coadd coefficients;
- complete within- and cross-observation covariance status;
- current SCI-NOI claim ceilings;
- exact WCS finite-population comparison;
- the ECS result and artifact-realization vocabularies;
- SCI-MAP-REQ-001 through REQ-052;
- SCI-MAP-PRED-001 through PRED-025;
- every current nonclaim.

Do not inspect implementation, configuration, schemas, tests, audits, repairs,
reductions, generated products, operational behavior, performance records,
production material, Unity material, web sources, or undocumented practice.

Amend existing requirement and prediction IDs when repairing the same
obligation. Add a new ID only for a genuinely new independent obligation.

======================================================================
1. CORRECT PROFILE REGISTRATION AND EVALUATION STATUS
======================================================================

The r0.2 source register says that the successor MAP and VAL source/profile
records remain candidate records whose owner acceptance, canonical activation,
and frozen identities are pending.

Do not state in unqualified present tense that:

    SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2
      is registered and evaluated by SCI-VAL

or that another candidate profile presently passes.

Track separately:

    profile_semantics_state
    scientific_owner_approval_state
    registry_registration_state
    source_binding_state
    activation/evaluability_state
    object-specific decision realization.

Use current candidate truth:

    scientific semantics:
        candidate

    owner acceptance:
        pending

    canonical Registry/source activation:
        pending

    SCI-VAL evaluability:
        unavailable

    realized decision for a particular object:
        unavailable.

Preferred wording:

    SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2 is the proposed
    owner-governed aggregate-profile identity for this candidate.
    After exact owner acceptance, canonical Registry/source binding, and
    activation, SCI-VAL may evaluate it for a requested object.

Apply the same status audit to:

- SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2;
- SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2;
- the uniform coefficient handoff profile;
- the uniform coefficient Registry/family records;
- the original-footprint coordinate boundary;
- every source/register/profile statement;
- every route-status and remaining-gate table.

An owner-accepted scientific core does not silently activate a draft Registry
record or manufacture a realized VAL decision.

======================================================================
2. DEFINE THE EMPTY-SUPPORT PRODUCT OUTCOME
======================================================================

The contract allows an authorized coverage_cut above one to produce:

    S_out = empty set

or, for coaddition:

    S_out_coadd = empty set.

Return one explicit scientific-owner disposition.

Preferred disposition:

    application state:
        applied_no_support_authorized_output_rows

    product outcome:
        not_produced

    cause:
        no_support_authorized_output_rows.

Retain:

- request, effective, observation_resolved, and applied state;
- exact parent and plan;
- coefficient/projection/support identities;
- Q_star, thresholds, and support predicates;
- proof that the output-row set is empty;
- attempt identity, cause, and provenance.

Do not publish:

- a dense zero-valued map;
- a zero-sky measurement;
- a valid ordinary signal plane;
- an admitted coadd member with no scientific rows;
- a fabricated response or covariance plane.

If the owner instead authorizes an immutable empty-row scientific bundle,
define explicitly:

- its exact product role and identity;
- whether it is realized or not_produced;
- base-product validity;
- publication;
- coadd admission;
- response and covariance state;
- exposure and count state;
- downstream consumption;
- storage representation.

Do not leave this choice to implementation or file-writing behavior.

Update:

- the support equations and surrounding text;
- SCI-MAP-REQ-009, REQ-012, REQ-031 through REQ-033, REQ-039,
  REQ-047, and REQ-048 as applicable;
- SCI-MAP-PRED-012, PRED-015, PRED-017, and PRED-025;
- ECS fixtures and failure-state tables.

======================================================================
3. SEPARATE PRODUCT REALIZATION FROM ATTEMPT FAILURE
======================================================================

Do not define realized as binding product “failures” while also saying that a
post-application terminal failure has no realized product.

Keep distinct:

A. MAP product realization

    actual immutable accumulators, scientific output rows, product values,
    product-role statuses, and provenance were produced;

B. application-attempt outcome

    succeeded
    failed
    not_produced

or exact library-compatible equivalents.

A failed application may produce an immutable failure/evidence record, but that
record does not make the MAP product realized.

An unavailable response or covariance status inside a permitted base bundle is
a realized companion-status fact and is not producer failure.

A pre-application stop has no applied or realized product record.

A post-application terminal failure retains:

- applied-attempt identity;
- failure stage;
- cause;
- affected scope;
- nonmutation evidence;

but has no realized MAP signal product or completion marker.

Repair the lifecycle definition, table, provenance requirement, failure
section, and ECS record model consistently.

======================================================================
4. BIND THE RESPONSE FAMILY OF EACH RESPONSE-BEARING COADD
======================================================================

The current coadd equation stacks compatible fixed-state observation responses,
while the product-role language can be read as allowing any named response
family.

Define one exact response-family-qualified construction.

For response family R:

    T_obs^(R)
      = ordered stack of exact compatible member responses R_o^(R);

    R_coadd,out^(R)
      = B_out T_obs^(R),

only when:

- every admitted member has the same exact response-family identity;
- source domain, perturbation definition, basis, unit, normalization,
  reference/gauge/null state, WCS/grid, and row mapping are compatible;
- coadd membership, centered-integer placement, B_out, support, and coadd
  coefficient state are fixed for that query;
- the response family is mathematically composable through the fixed linear
  coadd operator.

SCI-MAP:response_bearing_coadd@1 shall bind the exact response-family identity
it carries.

Do not combine in one unqualified role:

- fixed-state response;
- PTC full-procedure finite difference;
- PTC+MAP re-resolved response;
- coadd re-resolved/full-procedure response;
- whole-chain response.

If perturbation may alter observation admission, coadd membership, support,
placement, coadd coefficients, product role, or the coadd plan, define a
separate coadd-full-procedure or coadd-re-resolved response family with its own
comparison-space record.

Until separately authorized, that coadd-procedure response is unavailable.

A finite-difference response is not multiplied through B_out as though it were
a linear Jacobian without an exact composition theorem.

Update:

- Equation 40 and T_obs notation;
- product-role dependency table;
- SCI-MAP-REQ-036, REQ-037, REQ-040, and REQ-043;
- SCI-MAP-PRED-013 through PRED-016;
- response records and ECS fixtures.

======================================================================
5. MAKE DOCUMENT AUTHORITY ROLES UNAMBIGUOUS
======================================================================

Use the following hierarchy:

    SCI-MAP-v0.2-SHARED-AUTHORITY
        = sole normative scientific source;

    Formal Scientific/Engineering Contract PDF
        = canonical rendered normative scientific view;

    Science-Team Rationale
        = explanatory scientist-facing view;
          no independent authority;

    Engineering Conformance Specification
        = prospective evidence, execution, traceability, and verdict
          procedure;
          no independent science.

The formal contract may carry conformance routing and claim boundaries. It is
not the sole detailed conformance procedure.

Repair the rationale-cover statement that currently assigns the conformance
procedure to the formal contract.

All three covers shall bind the identical shared authority, author packet,
owner directive, and build record.

======================================================================
6. REPAIR THE COMPARISON-SPACE CROSS-REFERENCE
======================================================================

Replace malformed wording equivalent to:

    shall bind the complete comparison-space record in A numerical
    full-procedure difference is defined only by ...

with an exact named reference such as:

    shall bind the complete
    SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE record defined in Section <X>.

Use that same stable record identity in:

- formal equations and requirements;
- response prose;
- ECS requirements and fixtures;
- provenance;
- product boundaries.

Repair duplicate punctuation and any stale prose introduced by the broken
reference without changing the comparison-space science.

Do not imply that scientific freeze itself registers, activates, or realizes a
